title: Novice programming task with web-search and GenAI choices
summary: Novice programmers work on a programming problem while deciding whether to seek help through web search or generative AI. The research task captures tool-choice intentions and behavior, allowing comparison of the factors that drive students toward conventional web resources or GenAI support.

sources.title: An Investigation of the Drivers of Novice Programmers' Intentions to Use Web Search and GenAI

assessment.summary: Solve a programming problem while choosing between web-search and GenAI help resources.
student_actions: Choose and use available help resources.

student_role.description: GenAI is one of the help resources available during the research task.

allowed_purposes: Help seeking while solving the programming task
